steps.title: Register the learned task
steps.instructions: Reconstructed workflow from the published prompt and available result artifacts; this is not a recorded sequence of agent turns. Follow the run report’s phase command, state-based rewards, termination costs and inherited observation contract. Use reinforcement learning rather than scripted joint animation.

steps.title: Test before training
steps.instructions: Run the local configuration and repository tests, then the 64-environment, five-iteration CUDA smoke gate. Obtain your own compute authorization and credentials before reproducing paid jobs.

steps.title: Train and export
steps.instructions: The recorded final run used 4,096 environments and 3,500 PPO iterations on A10G, followed by supported ONNX export. Preserve checkpoints without exposing credentials or private repositories.

steps.title: Evaluate the policy
steps.instructions: Use the supported inference path for a 16-second nominal rollout and 32-environment perturbation battery; compare the published metrics and preview. Stability is demonstrated in simulation; exact phrase identity and physical transfer are not proven.
